What is real today

The backend has configured HTTP tests, Mecatl execution, broker enforcement, Kubernetes Jobs, durable Stop and evidence exports. The recorded owned-lab results are separate from this fictional UI.

Read implementation status

What these screens propose

Guided onboarding, workspace identity, built-in profile selection, plan presentation and a review experience. No UI action calls an API, starts a worker or verifies permission.
